Questions and answers

What is 受託手荷物タグ?

In this glossary, 受託手荷物タグ refers to: Barcode or RFID label affixed to hold-loaded baggage to identify routing, weight and ownership.

How is 受託手荷物タグ used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "オペレーション、バーコードリーダーが642便の受託手荷物タグを読み取れません。手入力と経路確認を要請。"

Definition

Barcode or RFID label affixed to hold-loaded baggage to identify routing, weight and ownership.

Operational example

Operations, barcode scanner cannot read checked baggage tag for flight six-four-two; request manual entry and confirmation of routing to destination.
